summary.en: Renji Matsuo is working as secretary for Nanako Eguchi, mayor of Toraharu city. He has been waiting at one of Eguchi’s cars, waiting for her, when his phone suddenly rings. When he picks up the call, the other end of the line blares the referee’s whistle loudly, causing the pipe bomb installed under the car Matsuo has been standing to explode. The man is left gravely injured for the rest of the episode.

locations: In front of Toraharu City Hall
